name: start_timer
description: Start a countdown timer on the cook's phone. Use it whenever a step has a fixed time, or the cook asks for one. The result is the new timer's id; keep it to cancel the timer later.

label.description: Short name read aloud when the timer ends, e.g. "pasta" or "onions". Never empty.

seconds.description: How long the timer runs, in whole seconds. At least 1.

name: cancel_timer
description: Cancel a running timer on the cook's phone, e.g. when the cook says the pasta's already done.

name: go_to_step
description: Move the cook to a step of the recipe. Use it when you start talking them through a different step, forwards or back.

index.description: Zero-based index into the recipe's steps. 0 is the first step.

name: set_stage
description: Move the session to another stage when the cook moves on: decide (pick what to cook), prep (mise en place), cook, present (plating and serving), feedback (how it went).

name: show
description: Put something on the cook's screen for a glance: the current step, the ingredient list, or what done looks like for the current step.

name: note
description: Save a fact about the cook worth remembering next time, e.g. "hates coriander" or "likes their eggs runny". It's kept for after the cook; the cook doesn't see it.

fact.description: One short fact, in plain words. Never empty.
